name: geFlipper
blurb: Grand Exchange flipping. Finds the margin, places both sides, re-prices when the book moves.

name: Sarachnis Slayer
blurb: Full Sarachnis loop with banking, gear checks and a prayer-flick rotation that doesn't waste points.
feats: Eats and escapes on low HP

name: Scurrius Farmer
blurb: Low-level boss grinder for Scurrius. Solo instances, food runs, and it knows when to leave.

name: Wine Maker
blurb: Grapes and jugs of water into wine, on repeat. One of the fastest Cooking methods in the game.

name: Woodcutting Pro
blurb: Trees, banking and world hopping when the spot gets crowded. Tree types set themselves by level.

name: Herblore Cleaner
blurb: Cleans grimy herbs and makes unfinished potions from your bank. Cheap levels while you're at work.
feats: Stops when the bank runs dry
